abstract: OBJECTIVE: To compare laparoscope-assisted transvaginal removal of dermoid cysts to more standard laparoscopic cystectomy techniques. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective review of 44 laparoscopic dermoid removals performed at Olive View-UCLA Medical Center between 1992 and 1995. Cases were divided into three groups based on surgical approach: 1) conventional laparoscopic ovarian cystectomy, 2) laparoscopic ovarian cystectomy and removal of the freed mass via colpotomy, and 3) laparoscopic inspection, then transvaginal cystectomy via colpotomy. Surgical time, estimated blood loss, cyst spillage, and complications were compared. RESULTS: There were 11-19 patients in each group. The groups were similar in patient age, parity, and weight. Larger cysts tended to be removed by the laparoscopy-colpotomy techniques (mean diameter 10 cm) rather than by the purely laparoscopic approach (mean diameter 7 cm, P < .05). Cyst spillage occurred less often (43%, P < .05) and surgical time was shortest (mean 81 minutes, P < .05) with laparoscope-assisted transvaginal ovarian cystectomy compared with conventional laparoscopic techniques. Disposable laparoscopic instruments were used less often with transvaginal cystectomy (7%) than with conventional laparoscopic cystectomy (77%, P < .01). The difference in mean estimated blood loss in the cases using colpotomy (89 mL) compared with cases that did not (65 mL) was not statistically significant. Among the three groups, there were four major operative complications related to blood loss and infection. CONCLUSION: Laparoscope-assisted transvaginal ovarian cystectomy allows the removal of larger dermoid cysts, with less cyst spillage and savings in operative time and equipment compared with conventional laparoscopic cystectomy.
abstract_ja: 目的：腹腔鏡補助下経膣的に類皮嚢腫を摘出する方法を、標準的な腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術と比較すること。方法：1992年から1995年にOlive View-UCLA医療センターで施行された腹腔鏡下類皮嚢腫摘出術44例を後方視的に検討した。症例は手術アプローチにより3群に分けた。1)従来の腹腔鏡下卵巣嚢腫摘出術、2)腹腔鏡下卵巣嚢腫摘出後、遊離した腫瘤を膣円蓋切開から摘出、3)腹腔鏡での観察後、膣円蓋切開による経膣的嚢腫摘出。手術時間、推定出血量、嚢腫破綻、合併症を比較した。結果：各群11〜19例であった。3群は年齢、経産回数、体重が類似していた。大きな嚢腫は腹腔鏡-膣円蓋切開法で摘出される傾向があった(平均直径10cm)一方、純粋な腹腔鏡法では平均直径7cmであった(P<.05)。腹腔鏡補助下経膣的卵巣嚢腫摘出術では、従来の腹腔鏡下技術に比べて嚢腫破綻が少なく(43%、P<.05)、手術時間が最も短かった(平均81分、P<.05)。経膣的嚢腫摘出では使い捨て腹腔鏡器具の使用が少なかった(7%対従来法の77%、P<.01)。膣円蓋切開を行った症例の推定出血量(89mL)と行わなかった症例(65mL)との差は統計学的に有意ではなかった。3群中、出血と感染に関連する主要な手術合併症が4例あった。結論：腹腔鏡補助下経膣的卵巣嚢腫摘出術は、従来の腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術と比べ、より大きな類皮嚢腫の摘出を可能にし、嚢腫破綻と手術時間、器具の使用を減らせる。
